text: Czy jest dostęp dla wózków inwalidzkich?
ipa: tʃɨ jɛzd dˈɔstɛmb dla vˈuskuf ˌinvalˈitskix

literal: asysta is the Polish rail term for staff help for a passenger with reduced mobility
may I board before the others?
please guide me by the arm

text: Czy woda z kranu jest zdatna do picia?
ipa: tʃɨ vˈɔda s krˈanu jɛzd zdˈatna dɔ pˈitɕa

text: Czy mogę dostać klucz do toalety?
ipa: tʃɨ mˈɔɡɛ dˈɔstatɕ klˈudʒ dɔ tˌɔalˈɛtɨ

literal: the Polish out-of-order notice; nieczynne is the closed sign
does the paper go in the bowl?
rare in Poland; this is the descriptive term
